row.evidence: NiCE's help centre says 'With a SCIM integration, you can create, update, and delete NiCE CXone users using a third-party identity provider', with no plan restriction; the pricing page does not mention SCIM or SSO.
row.notes: New row (formerly NICE inContact; now NiCE CXone Mpower). Packages are per agent per month: Omnichannel Suite $110, Essential $135, Core $169, Complete $209, Ultimate $249 (plus $0.25 per session), billed monthly in arrears; no annual price shown, so the monthly price is recorded. SCIM is a CXone admin (User Hub) feature with no documented package gate or add-on, so it is recorded on the cheapest package; that gate is inferred from absence (no page says 'all packages'), hence medium confidence. SCIM 2.0 at https://{region}.{domain}/scim/v2 (bearer token adds /oauth; tokens last one year); Users and Schemas only, no Groups and no DELETE; IdP unassignment deactivates the employee. Okta guide uses a custom SWA app with SCIM enabled (the 2020 OIN 'Nice inContact' listing is not used); other IdPs use the generic endpoint. The User Management REST API covers create, update, deactivate, revive, invite and teams.

plans.name: Ultimate Suite
plans.price_text: $249 per agent per month / $0.25 per session

scim.base_url: https://{region code}.{domain}/scim/v2 (bearer token: https://{region code}.{domain}/oauth/scim/v2, e.g. https://na1.nice-incontact.com/oauth/scim/v2)

auth.token_source: Admin > Tenant Configuration > Account Settings > SCIM tab (Generate); alternatively OAuth 2.0 app registration (Okta) or access key pair from an employee profile

endpoints.notes: The SCIM OpenAPI lists only /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Schemas (plus /basic-auth/ variants).

operations.notes: The SCIM help page says IdPs can 'delete' users, but the API has no DELETE method and the Okta guide deactivates; delete recorded as false.

custom.how: NiCE extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:nice:2.0:User with team and loginAuthenticator; optional fields must be enabled on the Account Settings page.

roles.how: SCIM roles attribute; IdP-created users default to the Agent role (or another default role) and roles can be changed in CXone.

limitations.text: One-way sync: changes made in CXone do not flow back to the IdP; user status can only be changed in the IdP.
Provisioning fails if the tenant has no role named Agent (unless a different default role is enabled).
No SCIM Groups endpoint; teams are set through the NiCE extension attribute.

scim.notes: SCIM plan is inferred: no package gate is documented.

endpoints.purpose: Get list of all users for a tenant

okta.notes: OIN 'Nice inContact' listing (last updated 2020) does not show which features it supports; NiCE's own Okta guide builds a custom SWA app with SCIM enabled instead.

entra.notes: Microsoft's tutorial covers SSO only; NiCE says other IdPs use the generic SCIM endpoint.
